item.title: Builders and Dreamers
item.description: This summer, I'll be spending five days in the woods near Berlin at DWebCamp — a gathering for builders and dreamers of a better web. July 8–12, Alte Hölle. I'm hosting an accessibility clinic: no theory, just hands-on audits of real projects. And giving a talk about RSS — the OG Simple Resilient Root System — and why it's worth fighting for.

item.title: A Small Shout-Out to My Students
item.description: This semester, a group of students in the web topics advanced elective explored linked data, federated web, ActivityPub, Webmention, and Solid. They also experimented with tools such as three.js, cables.gl, and TouchDesigner to create interactive media projects. LinkedIn-style boasting isn’t my strong suit, but I’m very proud of the work they’ve done. I invited them to Courtray for the Wonder creativity festival, to KBR in Brussels to meet Sven Lieber, and to the Wintercircus Ghent for a talk about TouchDesigner.

item.title: More to Come
item.description: As is tradition in January, I’ve curated a small list of good intentions for 2025. The basic fit will probably be saturated with other well-intentioned people... so I’ll avoid getting in their way. What’s left is a very real desire to share at least one observation with the world through this blog. And yes, I antedated this post so the one above wouldn’t look lonely. Please don’t tell anyone. 😉
